title: Building the Ultimate £1,500 Chinese Gravel Bike

takeaways.text: The owner paid about £570 for the frame, fork, seatpost, bar and hardware package; the frame has UDH and a down-tube storage box (April 2026).

text_i18n.zh-Hans: 车主为包含车架、前叉、座管、车把和配件的套装支付了约570英镑；车架带 UDH 和下管储物盒（2026年4月）。
text_i18n.de: Der Besitzer zahlte etwa 570 Pfund für das Paket aus Rahmen, Gabel, Sattelstütze, Lenker und Kleinteilen; der Rahmen hat UDH und ein Staufach im Unterrohr (April 2026).

takeaways.text: A 44T chainring with 3 mm offset had extremely tight chainstay clearance, so he planned a zero-offset ring; 47 mm Vittoria Terreno Dry tires fitted.

text_i18n.zh-Hans: 偏移3毫米的44T 牙盘与后下叉间隙极小，所以他打算换零偏移牙盘；47毫米 Vittoria Terreno Dry 轮胎装得下。
text_i18n.de: Ein 44er-Kettenblatt mit 3 mm Offset hatte extrem wenig Abstand zur Kettenstrebe, daher plante er ein Blatt ohne Offset; 47-mm-Reifen Vittoria Terreno Dry passten.

takeaways.text: His size-L build with Wheeltop GeX 1×12, a 10–50 cassette, 1,283 g carbon wheels and 47 mm tires weighed 8.04 kg without pedals, cages or mount.

text_i18n.zh-Hans: 他的 L 码整车配 Wheeltop GeX 1×12、10–50飞轮、1,283克碳轮和47毫米轮胎，不含脚踏、水壶架和支架重8.04公斤。
text_i18n.de: Sein Aufbau in L mit Wheeltop GeX 1×12, 10–50-Kassette, 1.283 g schweren Carbonlaufrädern und 47-mm-Reifen wog ohne Pedale, Flaschenhalter und Halterung 8,04 kg.

disclosure: The creator describes upgrading his own bike; the description includes commercial referral links and discount codes. Frame-supply terms remain unknown.
summary: Custom LCG071-PRO upgrade build with Wheeltop GeX, carbon wheels and cranks. The description names the exact PRO frame; it does not establish LCG071S-PRO specifications or current China prices.
